metadata.description: Local marketplace for the AI Content Team OS plugin.

plugins.name: ai-content-team-os
plugins.description: One command that mines your own Instagram comments for ideas, learns your voice from a corpus of your real posts, researches the day, and publishes one artifact holding nine ready-to-post options - three Instagram with Reel scripts, three LinkedIn, three X - each with a confidence score. Click POST on the one you want, say "post", and Claude drives your Chrome to publish it. Runs only when you run it; never on a schedule.
